newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end soft, seen pausing for breath.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end soft, seen pausing for breath.

text.p: 1325 GMT - Austrian shares end moderately soft after aimless trade on Monday.
Traders expect market to consolidate around present levels before launching fresh assault on the upside.
Sentiment buoyant. Profittaking cited in OMV and VA Stahl.
* Six ATX shares higher, 14 lower and three unchanged.
* February ATX future down 3.6 points at 1,181.4 on turnover of 536 contracts.
* Leading decliner Wolford, down 2.34 percent at 1,421 schillings.
* Top gainer EA Generali ordinaries, up 1.54 percent at 3,300.
